description.value: The Sandman Signature Hotel & Suites Langley is a full-service hotel offering a range of room types from standard rooms to loft and jacuzzi suites, many with kitchenettes or full kitchens. It holds a GreenStep Silver Certification for sustainability practices measured against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Touring cyclists will find an on-site restaurant (Moxies), indoor pool, 24-hour front desk, and free parking, though bike-specific services are not documented online.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms hotel amenities including free WiFi, free parking, on-site Moxies restaurant, indoor pool, 24-hour front desk, and washer/dryer in select suite rooms. No mention of bike-specific amenities (secure bike storage, bike procedure, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash) appears anywhere in the website content. The website title 'Sandman Signature Hotel & Suites Langley' differs slightly from the OSM name 'Sandman Signature Hotel', which is worth flagging.
concerns: Website title is 'Sandman Signature Hotel & Suites Langley', which differs from the OSM name 'Sandman Signature Hotel' — OSM name may be truncated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service hotel with good general traveller amenities, but neither required cycling criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) is confirmed by the website. Direct outreach needed to determine suitability for the WWC directory.

Laundry.detail: Washer/dryer included in Standard Suite (1 King Bed, Sofa Bed, Kitchen) room type per website room listings

Nearby evening food.detail: Moxies restaurant on-site with room service available, listed as a hotel amenity

Device charging.detail: USB charging ports listed as a room feature in the Standard Room description
